package.description: Automated roaming and watchdog manager for WireGuard on Windows

en-US.description: Automated roaming and watchdog manager for WireGuard on Windows
en-US.longDescription: WireFox bridges the missing link of WireGuard on Windows with intelligent background roaming and kernel-level tunnel watchdog protection. Auto-disconnects on trusted home Wi-Fi and gateways, auto-connects on untrusted networks, and defends against ARP spoofing.
en-US.name: WireFox
